additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. Later final Questionnaire enableWhen work, especially FHIR-15665 and commit 651aa532afe40d621b6a593df3fabc0b86b0af62, dropped hasAnswer and introduced the current operator plus answer[x] model, so the current StructureDefinition no longer resembles the DSTU2 typo context. FHIR-13944 was a related old que-7 schematron correction but did not change the seed decision.
